reasons.business: Real problem and a distinctive hook. No monetisation design, a crowded market (screen-time blockers and gamified habit apps), Play-policy and IP-adjacency risk, and no evidence beyond n=1; the cap is 6 without real-user evidence.
reasons.pmf: The only evidence is the owner's run (progress.md:27): 2 of about 4 live days cleared, below the project's own 70% bar. Personality and Fitness quests are mostly honour-system.
reasons.technical: Pure-Dart rules engine, serialised writes, 253 Dart and 17 JVM tests passing, 82.8% coverage. But a reproduced wrongful-penalty bug on the DST fall-back night, an enforced penalty for a same-day quest after a restart, alarms on the device clock, and low platform-layer coverage.
reasons.uiux: Coherent, polished theme with reduced motion, semantics and a large-text test. Copy contradicts the near-miss rule, hold controls are 36 dp, onboarding is heavy, and the framing is penalty-led. Not device-tested by the auditor.
reasons.security: No INTERNET permission, backup off, minimal exported surface, compliant usage disclosure. The privacy policy omits free-text reflections and reasons, there is no in-app deletion of archives, and one unlogged clock-change bypass.
reasons.behavioural: Safety fixes are in: no exercise punishment, no carry-over, near miss, emergency exit, contest, rest-period protection. Still loss-framed, near misses get no feedback, the S hold resets on any miss, and social tasks run daily with no swaps.
reasons.retention: A threat-based loop with uninstall as the escape, honour fatigue, a heavy first session, no social pull, and weak n=1 data.
reasons.publication: The AAB meets targetSdk 36, has no network access and passes the release check. But a P0 is open, the listing claims the lock doubles, and the special-use foreground service declaration and video, the Health apps declaration and the 12-tester closed test are not done; the cap is 7.

findings.title: The day is judged about an hour early on the night DST ends (wrongful penalty)
findings.fix: Store the IANA zone id. Pin the day to the old offset only when the zone id changes; when the offset changes within the same zone (DST), use the local date and refresh zoneOffsetMinutes.
findings.acceptance: Probe tests with TZ=Europe/Berlin (2026-10-25 23:10) and TZ=America/New_York (2026-11-01 23:10) keep the day open until local midnight. Spring-forward is covered. Existing zone tests in test/app/verdict_and_zone_test.dart pass.

findings.title: An Awakening without a dry run issues an enforced quest due the same day (a 23:40 restart leads to a lock)
findings.fix: When dryRunDays is 0 (or after 18:00), start the System tomorrow, as chooseSystem already does. Show 'FIRST QUEST: tomorrow'.
findings.acceptance: Awaken at 23:40 with no dry run, then open the next day: no quest_failed for the Awakening day, no lock and no debt.

findings.title: The store listing and README say the Dungeon Penalty doubles the lock; the code never does
findings.fix: Change the copy to 'the normal lock; reading and phone-free penalties double'.
findings.acceptance: No 'double lock' or 'doubles the lock' remains in the listing or README; the listing matches the onboarding terms.

findings.title: Play Console declarations (special-use foreground service with video, Health apps) and the 12-tester, 14-day closed test are not done
findings.fix: Owner completes App content and starts the closed test.
findings.acceptance: Console App content complete; closed test with 12 or more testers running for 14 continuous days.

findings.title: Native enforcement is unverified on device for Android 15/16 and the owner's vendor skin (reboot, force stop, update, lock starting over an open app)
findings.fix: Run the manual device checklist and record the results.
findings.acceptance: Dated checklist results in BUILD_LOOP.md covering each scenario.

findings.title: Wake alarms use the device clock (RTC) while locks use trusted time; setting the clock back delays the lock wake-up, unlogged
findings.fix: Schedule ELAPSED_REALTIME_WAKEUP from the trusted delta; add a TIME_SET/TIMEZONE_CHANGED receiver that calls WatcherService.sync.
findings.acceptance: A JVM test for the alarm computation; on a device, with the clock set back 3 h, the lock still starts on time.

findings.title: Copy says partial completion is failure, contradicting the 80% near-miss rule
findings.fix: State the near-miss rule in the terms and on the quest footer.
findings.acceptance: Widget tests find the near-miss wording; no 'Partial completion is failure' remains.

findings.title: The privacy policy omits stored free text (reflections, exit and contest reasons, placement answers); there is no in-app deletion of archived trials
findings.fix: Update the web and in-app policy; add 'Delete old trials' in Settings.
findings.acceptance: The policy lists the free-text types; a widget test deletes archives.

findings.title: Near misses have no limit and no feedback (30/30 days with no XP and no Gate progress)
findings.fix: Show a System notice after 3 near misses in a row, suggesting the reduction valve.
findings.acceptance: A test with 3 consecutive near misses queues the notice.

findings.title: Hold controls are 36 dp high, below the 48 dp touch-target guidance
findings.fix: Raise the hit area to at least 48 dp.
findings.acceptance: A widget test asserts the size is at least 48 dp.

findings.title: Stat points have no effect in play
findings.fix: Remove allocation, or show only the trained stats.
findings.acceptance: A product decision is recorded and implemented.

findings.title: The watcher polls UsageEvents every 700 ms whenever a verdict is due (every morning until the app is opened)
findings.fix: Poll fast only while locked; poll every 3-5 s while only a verdict is due.
findings.acceptance: Battery use measured on device before and after.

findings.title: Store screenshots show a personal status bar and third-party app names, and the Personality System rather than the core Focus System
findings.fix: Recapture in a clean demo state, using Focus.
findings.acceptance: Four new screenshots with no third-party brand names.

findings.title: Focus E 'No phone after waking' is an unmeasured timer; Focus S 'apps locked all day' is an honour checkbox
findings.fix: Measure the first unlock after the rest period ends from usage events; enforce the Focus S lock with the watcher.
